notes: Re-derived on 2026-10-15 for the Pirate fork of Freedom Browser (AGPL-3.0-or-later) after it merged upstream v0.8.7 (tag commit 3a8c75e6). Upstream's component records were re-read against this tree and kept where they still hold; the fork's additions are recorded beside them: the committed Handshake helpers (hns-bin/), the committed V2Ray runtime (dvpn-bin/; its GeoIP/GeoSite data files were removed as unused), the Agora Web SDK vendor bundle, the dVPN SDK npm packages, and the fork's own assets/hns/ and scripts/jacktrip/ files. The inventory is derived from package.json build.extraResources, the committed per-target helper directories, src/renderer/vendor/ and the rest of src/; licenses-audit.test.js fails if this file drifts from any of them or from the committed helper bytes. Upstream's own audit (0.8.7, MPL-2.0 posture) is at 3a8c75e6:licenses-audit.json.

distribution_model.notes: The fork's Linux target is a deb only (build.linux.target); no AppImage or pacman package is built from this tree. macOS and Windows configuration is retained from upstream. better-sqlite3, freedom_ipfs_native.node, libradicle.node and Ant ship in every package. myotis-node.node, myotis-supervisor and Arti ship in macOS and Windows packages only, because build.linux.extraResources does not name them. hnsd, fingertipd and V2Ray are committed for linux-x64 only, matching src/shared/platform-capabilities.json, so only Linux x64 packages carry them. Pre-built third-party renderer libraries are committed under src/renderer/vendor/ and ship inside app.asar via the src/**/* files pattern, which also ships every other committed file under src/.

issues.details: Linux AppImage only. Since #566 every .AppImage starts with the static type-2 runtime as its ELF header; it mounts the squashfs image and execs Freedom, so Freedom is not linked to it. The runtime statically links libfuse 3.15.0 (LGPL-2.1) with upstream's patches/libfuse/mount.c.diff applied. The previous runtime (appimage-12.0.1) dlopen()ed the system libfuse.so.2 instead, so 0.8.7 is the first release whose AppImage carries LGPL-2.1 code. The .deb and pacman packages do not contain the runtime. Attribution is in NOTICES; until this revision none of the audit files recorded the runtime, because licenses-audit.test.js derives its inventory from build.extraResources and src/, and the runtime arrives through electron-builder's toolset instead.
issues.recommended_fix: Decided by the maintainer (2026-10-07): pointing to upstream's public source is sufficient. The runtime is a separate upstream program, unmodified by Freedom, and AppImage/type2-runtime publishes its complete source, build scripts and the libfuse patch at the pinned release 20251108 (libfuse 3.15.0 itself at libfuse/libfuse), which is what LGPL-2.1 section 6 needs for a user to rebuild and relink the runtime against a modified libfuse. NOTICES names that release and the libfuse version. Re-read the component list, and confirm the source stays published, on every build.toolsets.appimage or electron-builder bump.

issues.details: LGPL-3.0-only. resolved_since_last_audit.component: Individually held copyright notices (V2Ray modules, Agora bundle)
resolved_since_last_audit.details: MIT, BSD and ISC terms require the copyright notice itself to accompany binary redistribution. The Handshake helpers now meet this through the ported hns-bin/linux-x64/licenses/ bundle. For V2Ray's Go modules (twenty of whose copyright lines name individual authors) and the libraries embedded in the Agora bundle (core-js, formdata-polyfill, ua-parser-js 0.7.40, axios; only the first two keep their notices in the file), NOTICES gives the licence, the module or library and where the exact line is published, but not the line, because the workspace rule forbids writing personal names. Resolve by shipping the module archives' own licence files unedited in a dvpn-bin/linux-x64/licenses/ bundle bound by digest, as the HNS bundle does, and the equivalent for Agora's embedded libraries, or by an owner decision.
resolved_since_last_audit.resolution: Owner ruling: licence and NOTICE text the licences require is copied verbatim even where it names individual authors; nothing written for the fork names anyone. dvpn-bin/linux-x64/licenses/ now ships every embedded Go module's licence files unedited (72 files, each archive matching the binary's h1 sum), bound by sha256 in source-record.json and checked by licenses-audit.test.js; NOTICES copies each module's copyright lines verbatim and reproduces the licence files of the seven libraries identified in the Agora bundle from their npm packages.

resolved_since_last_audit.details: The Linux x64 evaluation deb built by the Linux evaluation deb workflow (run 38739559506) from commit c51e4fe01953f088fb2ff068b3e3c47bfa026e57, freedom-browser_0.7.15_amd64.deb with sha256 7a839551324758662fc10eec876d71af089b0b809039dcfa0698ac8c35399b40, was extracted and compared on 2026-10-15. resources/ holds ant-bin, freedom-ipfs-node, radicle-bin, hns-bin, dvpn-bin, jacktrip-scripts, assets, ant.yaml, default-bookmarks.json, LICENSE, NOTICES, apparmor-profile and app.asar(.unpacked), all classified here or below; apparmor-profile is electron-builder's generated AppArmor profile for /opt/Freedom/freedom (unconfined mode with userns, installed to /etc/apparmor.d/freedom by the maintainer script): first-party build output with no third-party content. There is no myotis-bin, arti-bin, geoip.dat or geosite.dat. hnsd, fingertipd, encrypted-validator.json, PROVENANCE.md and v2ray are byte-identical to the committed files, both licence bundles and LICENSE and NOTICES are identical to the tree, and app.asar carries src/renderer/vendor/AgoraRTC_N-4.24.0.js with sha256 f440fa2d. The control file declares libunbound8 and libc6 (>= 2.36). The build configuration has since raised the declared floor to libc6 (>= 2.39) and added libudev1, libasound2t64 | libasound2 (>= 1.0.17) and libgbm1; a package built with it needs the fresh inspection reinspect_when requires.

verdict.reinspect_when: Any change to package.json build configuration or extraResources, the helper bundles under hns-bin or dvpn-bin, src/renderer/vendor, NOTICES or LICENSE, or package-lock.json production dependencies requires inspecting a newly built package before this verdict holds again.
verdict.message: Cleared for the Linux x64 evaluation deb built from f8ac958145d0b98717718874aaa1c379481da014 (run 38860180070, sha256 d86047ad39f8b17a4df085c898059a8ebbaf9f62cb17f42d27d6431436169bfd), independently inspected on 2026-10-16. app.asar contains only src, node_modules and package.json; repository files and src/**/__tests__ helpers are excluded. All 438 shipped source files, the locked libveritas 0.4.5 verifier, LICENSE, NOTICES, committed HNS/V2Ray helpers and complete licence bundles match the reviewed sources. Downloaded Ant/IPFS/Radicle bytes match the accepted installation; no fresh source-build comparison is claimed for those three. The artifact contains 299 unique npm packages in 315 directories; this audit's 300 counts the resolved dependency graph, including a React peer that neither this deb nor the accepted d8aad2be deb ships. Every shipped name/version is locked and classified; the reviewed Ledger entry imports the signer subpath without React hooks. Compared with the accepted installation, retained app.asar files are unchanged; only test files are removed, and refreshed adblock lists and their manifest differ outside app.asar. The earlier c51e4fe0 inspection missed repository files in app.asar; d8aad2be fixed that inclusion error and b28aee56 excluded the remaining source test helpers. This clearance is limited to this evaluation artifact, not a public-release decision; upstream product identity and maintainer metadata remain an open fork decision.

required_actions.details: NOTICES must name every component under package.json build.extraResources and every non-source file the build.files src/**/* pattern ships, src/renderer/vendor/ included. licenses-audit.test.js enforces this and fails on any unclassified addition. It runs in the unit suite (npm test), not at packaging time.
Apache-2.0 section 4(d). Re-read https://github.com/biafra23/myotis/blob/<tag>/NOTICE on every version bump and copy any change into NOTICES.

src/renderer/vendor/openlv.esm.js must stay a single generated file containing only upstream LGPL code. Inlining it into an app bundle, or mixing Freedom code into it, would turn LGPL section 4 into an obligation Freedom cannot meet.

required_actions.action: Keep shipping Electron's LICENSES.chromium.html on macOS
required_actions.details: Linux and Windows packages inherit it from the Electron dist. macOS does not: electron-builder unlinks it, and the .dmg/-mac.zip carry only Freedom.app, so build.mac.extraResources copies it into Contents/Resources. Dropping that entry silently removes Chromium's third-party attribution from every macOS artifact; licenses-audit.test.js fails if it goes.

required_actions.action: Keep the AppImage runtime's attribution and source pointer current
required_actions.details: Only if an AppImage target is restored: the fork builds a deb only, so no artifact carries the static AppImage runtime today and NOTICES no longer attributes it. Restoring the target means restoring upstream's attribution (3a8c75e6:NOTICES) and its LGPL-2.1 source pointer.

required_actions.action: Ask libradicle upstream for LICENSE files
required_actions.details: solardev-xyz/libradicle declares MIT OR Apache-2.0 in Cargo.toml but commits no license text.

required_actions.action: Re-audit committed helpers whenever their bytes change
required_actions.details: hns-bin/ and dvpn-bin/ hold committed binaries with no version pin. licenses-audit.test.js compares each file's sha256 with this file and LICENSE_AUDIT.md; a new binary needs its linked components and notices re-derived before the digests are updated. For hnsd and fingertipd, update hns-bin/linux-x64/licenses/ and its source-record.json with the new source, notices and digests in the same change. For V2Ray, regenerate dvpn-bin/linux-x64/licenses/ from the new binary's module list in the same change.
Upstream Freedom code stays MPL-2.0 inside the AGPL fork. NOTICES must keep telling recipients so, with the MPL-2.0 text location and the source location. README.md and CONTRIBUTING.md match LICENSE.

required_actions.action: Ask Agora for licence and third-party notices
required_actions.details: agora-rtc-sdk-ng declares MIT only in package.json metadata and ships neither a licence file nor a notice list for the code its bundle embeds.
